localizations.en: Phew... Another day of hard work!

999008199.text: 準備をしてると、下校時間まであっという間ですね

localizations.en: When we're preparing, time really flies until school's out, doesn't it?

999008199.text:
とりあえず、ベースは大体できてきたね。
あと少しで試作品もできそうだし

localizations.en: We've pretty much got the foundation done. We should have a prototype ready soon too.

999008199.text: すみません、実作業を任せっきりで

localizations.en: I'm sorry for leaving all the actual work to you.

999008199.text:
いいんだよ。機械いじりは私の役目だから。
その分設計はフロッケに任せちゃってるし

localizations.en: Don't worry about it. Tinkering with machines is my job. Besides, I've been leaving all the design work to you.

999008199.text:
フロッケも見よう見まねですけどね。
参考になる論文や本が多くて助かってます

localizations.en: I'm just doing my best to figure things out. Thankfully, there are lots of helpful research papers and books to reference.

999008199.text: まあ、色んな企業や学校がこぞって研究してるしね

localizations.en: Well, every company and school out there is researching this stuff like crazy.

999008199.text:
ハイディさんのご両親が勤めている会社も、
確かＶＲ事業に関わってましたよね

localizations.en: Your parents' company is involved in VR business too, right Heidi?

999008199.text: ああ……うん。そうだった気がする

localizations.en: That's right, I think they are.

999008199.text:
ただ、今のところは順調ですけど……分からないことも
多いので、この先大丈夫かちょっと不安です……

localizations.en: Things are going smoothly so far, but there's still a lot I don't understand... I'm a bit worried about how we'll manage going forward.

999008199.text:
うちの学校にも専門で研究してる奴らがいるし、
ちょっと協力してもらえないか頼んでみようか

localizations.en: There are people at our school who specialize in this area. Maybe we could ask them to lend us a hand?

999008199.text: そうですね。そうできると心強いです

localizations.en: That sounds good. Having their help would be reassuring.

999008199.text:
ユナさんたちを見習って、私らも負担軽減しないとね。
正直、今でもかなり疲れ溜まってるし……

localizations.en: We should follow in Juna's footsteps and try to lighten our workload. Honestly, I'm already pretty worn out...

999008199.text:
フロッケは特に気を付けなよ。
元から身体強くないんだから

localizations.en: You especially need to be careful, Flocke. You're not exactly known for your physical stamina.

999008199.text: ありがとうございます。でも、フロッケは平気です！

localizations.en: Thank you for your concern, but I'm fine!

999008199.text:
むしろ、やる気がどんどん湧いてきて
止まらないくらいですから！

localizations.en: If anything, I'm getting more motivated by the minute!

999008199.text:
それが余計心配なんだけどなあ……
無理しないようにね

localizations.en: That's exactly what worries me... Just don't overdo it, okay?
